stem.text: At high altitudes, the oxygen content of the air may be a third of that at sea level.
As a person slowly climbs a mountain, their body gradually adjusts to the high altitude.
What is increased during this period of adjustment?

A.text: the concentration of haemoglobin in the red blood cells

B.text: the oxygen-carrying capacity of the haemoglobin

C.text: the number of red blood cells per $\text{mm}^{3}$ of blood

D.text: the rate at which haemoglobin releases oxygen into the tissues
